audit.whatIsWrong: Four side tokens read 'Skill' or 'Yorick' against why-lines saying the opposite: win[0]/phases[0] 'Skill' above whys[0] 'Yorick's ghouls and E slow zone you off the wave at Level 1'; win[3] and win[4] 'Skill' above whys[3] 'favour Yorick' and whys[4] 'leans Yorick'; win[6] 'Yorick' above whys[6] 'it evens out to a skill fight'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mourning Mist's armour reduction and its mark are absent from the page, and Dark Procession is described as a trap you must dodge rather than a wall you can break.
audit.why: Two things decide this lane and neither was written down. (1) Mourning Mist reduces armour, slows and MARKS you, and Riot's text says summoned units gain move speed moving toward marked targets — the E is the trigger that sends the Mist Walkers sprinting, so dodging the E, not the cage, is the actual defence. It also shreds the armour that report[8]'s Plated Steelcaps buys. (2) Dark Procession summons a DESTRUCTIBLE wall. A caged Dr. Mundo can attack it down; the page told him only not to get caught in it.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, wants.you[0], breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and report[11].t rewritten around the mark and the destructible wall.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dark Procession was listed as 30s in breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].
audit.why: It is 20/18/16/14/12. Maxed that is 12 seconds — less than half the stated figure, so a player timing a step-up off '30s' walks into a second cage. Mourning Mist's 12/11/10/9/8 was not listed at all.
audit.corrected: 20s at rank 1 / 12s maxed, and Mourning Mist at 12s rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grievous Wounds is never prescribed against Yorick anywhere in the matchup.
audit.why: Last Rites heals Yorick on a 6/5.5/5/4.5/4 cooldown — effectively every trade, and it is also an auto-attack reset so the wind-up is the burst tell. In an attrition lane against Dr. Mundo, that healing is what wins the long fight, and the _missing file flags needs-antiheal for exactly this matchup.
audit.corrected: wants.you[2] repurposed to name Grievous Wounds and the 4s Last Rites loop.

notes: The page told the player to dodge the cage and said nothing about Mourning Mist. That is backwards: the E is what marks him and accelerates every Mist Walker toward him, and it shreds the armour the recommended Plated Steelcaps buys. Dark Procession is also destructible terrain — a caged Dr. Mundo should be attacking the wall — and its cooldown was overstated by 10-18 seconds depending on rank. Grievous Wounds was missing entirely against a champion who heals off Last Rites every four seconds.
